purpose: Review a finite issuer lease-liability, right-of-use-asset, occupancy-commitment and lease-modification disclosure domain before opening source rows, filing text, lease or facility values, candidate values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.debt_maturity_boundary: Campaign161 concerns debt-maturity source admission. Borrowing principal due dates do not identify leased asset, lessor, renewal option, variable payment, termination right, modification or occupancy dependence.
repository_evidence.human_capital_boundary: Campaign164 freezes workforce and employee-productivity disclosures. Headcount or compensation does not establish facility use rights or lease obligations.
repository_evidence.operating_scale_boundary: Campaign168 freezes stores, sites, installed assets, production and adoption KPIs. A site count does not establish ownership versus lease, payment schedule, renewal, closure cost or contract flexibility.
repository_evidence.market_risk_boundary: Campaign174 mentions lease notionals only inside an unadmitted interest-rate exposure state. Campaign175 does not infer rate sensitivity or hedge effectiveness; it requires separate contract-level use-right and occupancy semantics.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current annual-report lease note cannot be projected backward without contract identity, commencement, modification, exercise, termination, impairment, correction and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact issuer filing, exchange announcement, statutory registry or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable observation identity

first-public timestamp, trading-session availability, reporting measurement date, lease commencement, modification, renewal, option exercise, termination, settlement, correction and supersession chain
issuer, listed security, subsidiary, branch, facility, land, building, equipment, vehicle, lessor and contract mapping without current-state leakage
lease taxonomy separating property, land-use right, equipment, vehicle, short-term, low-value, variable-payment, concession, sublease, finance lease and sale-and-leaseback states
currency, payment frequency, fixed and variable payment basis, discount rate, remaining term, maturity bucket, renewal and termination option semantics
right-of-use asset additions, depreciation, impairment, disposal and carrying-value identity linked to the corresponding lease liability where applicable
sale-and-leaseback transfer qualification, consideration, retained use right, financing substance, gain or loss and counterparty identity
lease modification, rent concession, scope increase or decrease, remeasurement, early termination, restoration obligation and cash-payment timing
owned-versus-leased facility identity and occupied, idle, closed, relocated or subleased state without treating missing disclosure as ownership or flexibility
missing, undisclosed, confidential, not-applicable, exempt short-term, exempt low-value, expired, terminated, true zero liability and zero payment semantics without favorable absence coding
complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, issuer and contract identifier history, delisting coverage, pagination and one-shot acceptance gates
parser, identity, timing, unit, asset-liability linkage, modification-chain and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: lease_liability_maturity_renewal_and_termination_option_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer lease-payment maturity profile and exercisable renewal or termination flexibility for operating assets and facilities.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted history freezes contract and asset identity, fixed/variable payments, discount rate, remaining term, maturity buckets, renewal and termination options, exercise judgments, modifications, first availability and complete 2019-2023 issuer coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: right_of_use_asset_addition_impairment_disposal_and_utilization_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer change in leased operating capacity through right-of-use asset additions, impairments, disposals, closures or subleases.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a point-in-time link among facility or asset identity, commencement, carrying value, depreciation, impairment, closure, disposal, sublease, restoration obligation, correction and publication timing.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: fixed_variable_short_term_and_low_value_lease_flexibility_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer mix of committed fixed lease payments, variable payments and short-term or low-value exemptions as an operating-flexibility state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Fixed versus variable consideration, sales or index linkage, exemption elections, expense-versus-cash identities, minimum commitments, unit normalization and historical revision semantics are not frozen in one complete cross-issuer contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: sale_and_leaseback_modification_concession_and_early_termination_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer financing or operating transition through sale-and-leaseback, lease modification, rent concession or early termination.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source links transaction and contract identity, transfer qualification, financing substance, consideration, retained use right, modification scope, concession period, remeasurement, termination payment, counterparty and first-public histories.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: debt_maturity_rent_expense_store_count_capex_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing debt, accounting-expense, operating-scale, capital-expenditure or security-price state relabeled as enterprise lease commitment or flexibility.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Borrowing maturities, aggregate rent expense, store counts, capex or price paths do not identify a lease contract, leased asset, payment basis, renewal option, modification or termination right; renaming them would not create a new primitive.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: lease_burden_flexibility_maturity_direction_scale_or_window_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A transform of lease liability, right-of-use asset, lease payment, maturity, expense or facility state against assets, revenue, EBITDA, cash flow, debt, sites or time.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing higher or lower lease burden, fixed versus variable mix, near versus long maturity, renewal assumption, denominator, industry subset, peer residual or event-age window before source admission would multiply hypotheses; more leasing can signal flexibility, growth or fixed-cost fragility.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_maturity_use_right_flexibility_and_modification_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint issuer lease state across payment maturity, right-of-use assets, contractual flexibility and modification events.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or selecting weights, ranks, gaps, interactions, filters or models would expand the search before any component has a complete source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct enterprise lease and operating-commitment states remain deferred at source admission; debt, accounting, scale, capex or security-price relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.
